answer: The price of trying is a 5-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, paid up front for every single name, while the walnut stays small. The walnut here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Aditbound puddler kibble licence is the proof, because a licence puddlers renew after smelting house trials. A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Every anchor is counted once. One violet, one entry.
